original.target_description: Experiment 2, concreteness categorization RT comparison for words with many versus few near semantic neighbors; participant sample for the within-subjects analysis.

n.sample_role: Participants completing Experiment 2; participant sample for within-subjects RT analyses, not words or trials.
n.exclusions: No participant exclusion is reported in Experiment 2. The word level was excluded; only correct-response trials entered RT analyses, and RTs more than two SD from the overall mean were excluded (4.1% of trials).
